name: A Quest
source:
This story is about three students, who are card fight fans, have an agreement with each other to play in upcoming tournament in the beginning, and they have a conflict before the day of the tournament. In the end, one of the friends solves the problem.
[From [url=https://junyu0727.itch.io/a-quest] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这个故事讲述了三个卡牌迷的学生，一开始就约定要参加即将到来的比赛，但在比赛前一天他们发生了冲突。最后，一位朋友解决了这个问题。
[来自[url=https://junyu0727.itch.io/a-quest] itch.io[/url]]
